prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished, realistic high-fidelity macOS Electron application UI design comparison comp for Codex Coco. This is a flat digital UI design, not a photo, not a poster, no device frame, no desktop wallpaper, no perspective. Landscape 1536x1024 composition, equal side margins: a complete primary app window on the left occupying about 1040x840, and a complete standalone 360x520 menu-bar popover on the right, aligned near the top. Keep every control and both windows fully visible. Product language Chinese, name always exactly "Codex Coco". Use the same following synthetic data and preserve these facts. A small external caption at bottom says "视觉样稿 · 示例数据". The page is for operating a desktop utility, not reading a document. Navigation rail is permanently compact icons only, 56px; macOS traffic-light controls at upper left; titlebar and left rail share a quiet gray background, main content an off-white rounded inset panel. In dark mode equivalent would exist later, but render this comp in light mode. Lucide-like consistent line icons; system sans type, precise tabular figures, clear readable Chinese; compact headings, clear button hierarchy, no giant marketing text or redundant explanatory paragraphs. Header inside content: "用量", account chip "p***e@example.com" and "ChatGPT Plus", a compact refresh button. Segmented page tabs "总览", "样本检测", "CLI 工具" keep auxiliary tools out of the overview. Overview focal information: two quota periods "5 小时额度" "剩余 75%" "12:30 恢复" and "7 天额度" "剩余 40%" "周五 09:00 恢复". Below, a horizontal three-value summary "今日 24.8k" "近 7 天 186k" "近 30 天 724k", explicitly tokens. A substantial compact 14-day daily usage bar chart with range switch "7 天 14 天 30 天", the 14-day choice active; axis and data legible. Last read state quiet: "刚刚更新". Do not add imaginary billed costs, model conversations, devices, CPU, health scores, storage capacity or software cleaning functions. Complete popover: compact header "Codex Coco" with settings icon; same two quotas and recovery times using a readable small visual; short today/week tokens row; one compact "外观" row with "已连接" and a small theme swatch strip as read-only summary; footer full width "打开主窗口" action. The popover is a glanceable collection of monitors, not a mini document or a long vertical list of explanatory paragraphs. It can have clickable navigation affordances but do not show write/apply actions. No fake logo, no mascot, no outer marketing headings. Give both windows the same visual system. No animation trails, no motion blur; show a crisp settled interactive state.
Direction A, SOFT INSTRUMENTS. A contemporary enamel instrument-panel vocabulary translated into minimal UI, NOT literal physical hardware: warm pearl gray shell, near-white content, softly tinted lavender and mint quota panels with large precise circular remaining-progress arcs, 75 and 40 integrated with percent labels. Charming but measured color: periwinkle #7164e8, mint #37ad90, apricot #eea05d, pale lilac #f0edff, pale mint #eaf7f0; neutral ink #262638. Focal moment is the pair of colorful quota instruments, enough scale to understand instantly, restrained shadows only to establish inset panel hierarchy, no embossed buttons, no toy-like icons. Rich color appears in data rather than saturated whole-page backgrounds. Clear hard hierarchy: segmented tabs, two meters, then quiet flat statistics and one calm daily chart. Popover is particularly tactile and refined: two little ring monitors in a shared light surface, optional fine separators, small rounded status badge; compact custom control feeling. Rounded panel corners 16px; controls 8px. White space is purposeful and compact, whole core overview fits the first viewport. The graph should visually belong to the same instrument family, no loud duplicate hero.
purpose: UI style exploration only; not an implemented screen
approval: 用户选择 A，保留圆环、柔彩和圆润圆角，明确授权压紧布局并先封装 Card/Box。
implementation: 语义 HTML/CSS/SVG；示例账号及数值仅供样稿，不进入运行时。
